About us

Skincare guidance that respects you

GlowHer Skincare exists to make skincare simpler, more honest and more enjoyable.

Our story

Skincare shopping can feel like a maze of exaggerated claims, endless steps and affiliate-driven hype. We started GlowHer Skincare to be the calmer alternative: a place that explains what ingredients do, shows you how to build a routine you can stick to, and helps you discover products that fit your skin and budget.

We are a new, independent project, so we are upfront about where we are. Our product pages are currently sample listings that show the kinds of products we compare. Real brands, prices and retailer links will appear as partnerships are confirmed, and every affiliate link will be clearly labelled.

What we stand for

Transparency

Affiliate relationships are disclosed on the page, in the footer and on a dedicated disclosure page.

Education first

We would rather you understand an ingredient than buy it because of a trend.

Skin-kind routines

Simple, gentle, patient. Less is often more.

Accuracy

We update guides when evidence or guidance changes and correct mistakes promptly.

Editorial standards

  • Content is written by our editorial team for general education. We are not a medical provider.
  • We do not fabricate reviews, ratings, testimonials or brand relationships.
  • Commercial relationships never decide what we write about an ingredient or a skin concern.
  • We encourage patch testing and sensible sun protection, and we point you to professionals when something needs medical attention.

Who we serve

Our guides are written in English for readers in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Europe. Product availability, regulations and sunscreen labelling vary by country, so always check the label of the product you buy locally.
